title: Unify Selection Windows as UI Components
description: Refactor compose algorithms window kinds so selection-specific windows are compose/ui component specializations instead of separate bespoke window kinds. Piece selection should be implemented as a Diagram variant with restricted selection behavior, and the same pattern should apply to related selection windows. Update existing implementation and extend existing tests only; do not add new test files.
summary: Fixed algorithm shell UX: TreeItem now respects explicit null labels (TreeRow label prop) so details panel rows no longer show raw i18n keys. Added createIpoAlgorithmLayout grouping VEC_INPUT+PIECES_SELECTION_INPUT in one tab stack with DESIGN_DIFF_OUTPUT and DESIGN_OUTPUT columns (~IPO layout). TreeRow forwards label; createAlgorithmLayout defaults to IPO layout. Exported createIpoAlgorithmLayout from algorithms bundle. Vitest: 134 passed in compose/ui.
